try { const roles = (claims.realm_access && claims.realm_access.roles) || []; if (roles.includes('seller')) role = 'seller'; else if (roles.includes('buyer')) role = 'buyer'; else if (roles.includes('admin')) role = 'admin'; } catch(e){}
if (!role && email) { const em = email.toLowerCase(); if (sellerEmail && em===sellerEmail) role='seller'; if (buyerEmail && em===buyerEmail) role='buyer'; }
